title: Rep. Jimmy Patronis: Big Tech Must Be Held Accountable Now | NTD
text:
Rep. Jimmy Patronis (R-Fla.) speaks with NTD to share why he thinks Big Tech must be held accountable, and why he is pushing to repeal Section 230. This comes as Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testifies in a landmark trial accusing social media companies of harming children's mental health.
